parsed.rationale: The Miza - Playlist extraction API directly supports retrieving playlist information from SoundCloud, which matches the subtask of finding a playlist on SoundCloud with a mix of classic hits and current chart-toppers. It requires a search parameter that can be constructed from the user request or subtask inputs. Other music APIs either focus on song search or lyrics, not playlist extraction from SoundCloud.
